name: Franklin FTSE South Korea ETF
thesis: This is NOT a bottom-up name — it's a sized cyclical exposure to Korean memory semis (Samsung + SK Hynix combined ~25%+ of the basket) playing the DRAM/NAND/HBM upcycle, with hyperscaler AI capex as the demand pull. Position-sizing rules and exit triggers matter more than KPI tracking — the thesis breaks when the cycle turns. Single-signal break design: any one of the top three indicators trips the position.
key_driver: Memory cycle: DRAM/NAND pricing + inventory levels + hyperscaler AI capex pull

tier_1_kpis.name: DRAM contract price (monthly)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Single monthly decline (immediate trigger — no waiting for confirmation)

tier_1_kpis.name: Memory inventory weeks-of-supply (Micron as proxy)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Rises QoQ in Micron's reported numbers (MU is the English-language proxy since Samsung/SK Hynix financials are harder to source)

tier_1_kpis.name: MU forward guidance on bit shipments / pricing
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Guidance cut on either bit growth or price

tier_1_kpis.name: HBM allocation/pricing commentary
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Any indication of HBM3e/HBM4 allocation loss OR pricing reset lower (for SK Hynix/Samsung; readouts via MU + sell-side notes)
tier_1_kpis.source: MU + transcript readouts of SK Hynix/Samsung

tier_2_kpis.name: Nvidia data center revenue growth (downstream pull)

nuance.bear_case: HBM supply glut from competing Korean + Chinese capacity additions could compress pricing faster than current guidance models. China DRAM (CXMT) reaching parity in commodity DRAM would commoditize legacy nodes and pressure ASPs.
nuance.adversarial_take: AI capex cycle is what pulls memory pricing — if hyperscaler aggregate capex guides flat or down, the entire thesis pillar collapses regardless of HBM allocation.
nuance.stress_test: Single-signal design means the position should be exited promptly on first trip — no 'two consecutive months' deliberation. Bias is to leave fast and re-enter on confirmed re-acceleration rather than hold through a draw-down.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: AI capex cycle turns (any hyperscaler guides capex flat/down)
Single monthly decline in DRAM or NAND contract price

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters — operating loss.
Gross margin below 20% for 2 consecutive quarters — severe pricing/cost issue.
GAAP net income negative for 2 consecutive quarters — bottom-line loss.
Capex/Revenue above 25% for 2 consecutive Qs — capex bloat without proportional revenue.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken.
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.
